intent: HistoryStoreContractTest proves through an in-memory fake that the port contract appends once and reports false for a duplicate identity, appends token usage once per turn, and reads pages by session and tenant in keyset order; the port declares no update or delete member.

methods.semantics: rejects null entry and blank tenantId; false means duplicate identity

methods.signature: Mono<Boolean> appendUsage(String sessionId, String turnId, String tenantId, int promptTokens, int completionTokens)
methods.semantics: true when the usage row was inserted; false when the session id + turn id already has one (duplicate)

methods.signature: Flux<HistoryEntry> byIdAndTenant(String sessionId, String tenantId, String afterTurnId, int afterSequence, int limit)
methods.semantics: limit clamped to the configured maximum; rejects blank sessionId or tenantId
